name: Strawberry Sour Diesel Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Strawberry Sour Diesel crosses two legacy strains, Sour Diesel and Strawberry Cough, to create a fruity sativa with a serious gas kick. Expect sweet, candied strawberry on the inhale with hints of floral, followed by a sharp exhale of citrusy pine and classic diesel. Bold, flavorful, and perfect for on the go, this one’s got range.
